mandate: One pet per creation: arbitrary authored ink, a permanent hidden seed, and chronological care drive that SAME organism through potentially dramatic developmental forms guided by a scientifically sourced phylogenetic possibility map. No breeding, reproduction, offspring, multi-generation mechanics or heritable change between creatures.

lifecycle.completeMeans: Every acceptance marker is asserted in the focused test file and passes in CI. A task is not done from screenshots, prose or partial implementation.

invariants: One creature exists per creation. Its initial drawing, persistent identity, and hidden seed remain the same throughout its lifetime; no breeding, offspring or multi-generational progression.

The game uses a real phylogenetic reference as a branching map of possible developmental forms for the SAME creature over time. The observed affinity/path may progress, but is not literal taxonomic evolution or scientific ancestry-changing.
All apparent evolutionary changes are within one pet's lifetime. Genetic potential is assigned once and remains fixed; care affects how the potential is expressed.
No reference sprites, species IDs or historical stages in the runtime phenotype generator.
Retain exact authored birth ink and traceable source-material ancestry.
Scientific taxonomy and fictional extensions have distinct, inspectable provenance.
A replay witness is source drawing, seed, engine version, chronological care history, and times.
Avoid generated screenshots, recordings or diagnostic bulk files in main; use small deterministic numeric tests.
Every agent reads this plan before touching the engine, updates task status and acceptance tests together.

Product temporal contract (migration target): a physical anatomical change may commit only at T_k=hatchAtMs+k*86400000 for k=1..365, never between checks or after maturity; zero-change outcomes are valid.

Current 30-day forced lifespan and hourly/8192-hour anatomy are legacy implementation and must be superseded; preserve historical test evidence explicitly as legacy rather than claiming it is the new product behavior.

singleCreatureLifecycle.unitOfSimulation: one continuously identifiable organism across its entire lifetime
singleCreatureLifecycle.creation: one authored drawing plus one once-assigned alphanumeric random seed

Physiological play continues independently.
singleCreatureLifecycle.phylogeny: the scientific tree supplies hierarchical anatomical constraints and branching possibilities for single-pet developmental trajectories; stage affinities along its branches may change, but this is a game developmental metaphor, not a claim that an individual changes its actual scientific ancestry

terminology.phylogeneticDescendant: a reference taxon descended in the real tree of life, never offspring produced by this pet

anatomicalDevelopment.authority: APPROVED PRODUCT SPECIFICATION; migration in progress; old hourly/8192h source code and historical tests describe the prior implementation, NOT the desired model
anatomicalDevelopment.unitOfGrowth: one discrete physical-development opportunity each 86400000 elapsed milliseconds
anatomicalDevelopment.anchor: the individual pet's persisted clock.hatchAtMs (the moment a live organism hatches or is born); incubation does not consume a daily check
anatomicalDevelopment.checkTime: T_k = hatchAtMs + k*86400000, for integer 1 <= k <= 365, using safe integer UTC epoch milliseconds; not local midnight or calendar dates
anatomicalDevelopment.careWindows: Check k consumes only recorded chronological history on [T_(k-1), T_k); a command exactly at T_k belongs to the NEXT care window; no future observations or invented care while away
anatomicalDevelopment.anatomicalState: A(t)=A_0 for 0 <= t < T_1; A(t)=A_k for T_k <= t < T_(k+1) (1 <= k < 365); A(t)=A_365 for all t >= T_365, while alive. Each A_k is one verified fully physical graph
anatomicalDevelopment.checkOperation: A_k=F(A_(k-1),immutable birth drawing, fixed genotype, permanent chaotic seed/state, valid physical operators, summarized actual care window k, chronological resource bounds). Any F may be a physically constrained identity/null
anatomicalDevelopment.invariant: All new, removed, or relocated anatomical cells/tissues/links originate in explicit material transactions at exactly T_k; no anatomical mutations at fractional/hourly times, in renderer, or after T_365
anatomicalDevelopment.timelineTime: Use elapsed 24h intervals, including time zone/DST changes; app sessions, reopening, preview scrubbing and render frames cannot trigger extra checks
anatomicalDevelopment.missedChecks: On return, replay due check indices in ascending order using recorded evidence and the game's actual absent-state effects; no fabricated player commands, no batch leap that skips a check, at most 365 lifetime physical checks
anatomicalDevelopment.snapshots: Memoize the last validated completed check by persistent birth/genome/care-prefix identity; deterministic fresh replay from authored birth must reproduce every material transaction and graph exactly
anatomicalDevelopment.independentGameplay: Physiology, needs, care, death from legitimate gameplay causes, animation, locomotion, pose and surface appearance may continue between/after checks; none may silently mutate physical anatomy
anatomicalDevelopment.lifePolicy: Retire GAME_RULES.lifespanMs=30*DAY as a forced maximum. A still-living pet must be able to reach check 365; natural/care-driven death before then may legitimately end its remaining opportunities. A surviving pet can live after anatomical maturity
